repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v5.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-json
      - id: check-added-large-files
      - id: mixed-line-ending

  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: kotlin-lint
        name: Kotlin lint (ktlint + detekt)
        entry: mise exec -- ./gradlew ktlintCheck detekt
        language: system
        types: [kotlin]
        exclude: ".*/(build|\\.gradle|gradle/|generated/|\\.specify/|\\.vale/|\\.claude/).*"

  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
    rev: v8.24.2
    hooks:
      - id: gitleaks

  - repo: https://github.com/crate-ci/typos
    rev: v1.28.4
    hooks:
      - id: typos
        args: [--config, _typos.toml]

  - repo: https://github.com/errata-ai/vale
    rev: v3.21.0
    hooks:
      - id: vale
        args: [--config, .vale.ini, .]

  - repo: https://github.com/compilerla/conventional-pre-commit
    rev: v1.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: conventional-pre-commit
        stages: [commit-msg]

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v5.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-json
      - id: check-added-large-files
      - id: mixed-line-ending

  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: kotlin-lint
        name: Kotlin lint (ktlint + detekt)
        entry: mise exec -- ./gradlew ktlintCheck detekt
        language: system
        types: [kotlin]
        exclude: ".*/(build|\\.gradle|gradle/|generated/|\\.specify/|\\.vale/|\\.claude/).*"

  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
    rev: v8.24.2
    hooks:
      - id: gitleaks

  - repo: https://github.com/crate-ci/typos
    rev: v1.28.4
    hooks:
      - id: typos
        args: [--config, _typos.toml]

  - repo: https://github.com/errata-ai/vale
    rev: v3.21.0
    hooks:
      - id: vale
        args: [--config, .vale.ini, .]

  - repo: https://github.com/compilerla/conventional-pre-commit
    rev: v1.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: conventional-pre-commit
        stages: [commit-msg]
